record.learning: When a scanner whitelists sidecar IO by declared runtime, keep every accepted runtime usable by allowing only its bounded stdio surface on the declared sidecar entrypoint.
evidence: CAS footgun-finder 019f3085-cb85-79d2-bfca-c64bf241abfe found Deno was accepted by validateSidecarCommand but Deno stdio was unconditionally rejected; bun test and bun run proof passed after harness/pack-utils.mjs and test/adapter_self_containment.test.mjs fix.
record.application: For future sidecar runtime changes, update runtime validation, self-containment allowlists, docs, and entrypoint-bound regressions together.

record.learning: When a capability adapter duplicates manifest policy fields, prefer a verifier parity check that requires adapter manifest() to expose and match the full enforced policy surface, including secrets, because otherwise verified packs can drift and reject callers that followed the published manifest.
evidence: Post-fix footgun CAS 019f30b2-1490-7541-a184-70342b36639d found verified packs could still drift between manifest and adapter policy fields; verifyPack parity checks plus adapter secretRequirements exposure fixed it with bun test and bun run proof passing.
record.application: For future pack policy changes, update adapter manifest(), manifest.json, checksums, pack fingerprints, and verifier parity tests together before review-closeout.

record.learning: When a self-containment scanner accepts extensionless local imports, prefer covering every host runtime resolution candidate, including alternate executable extensions and JSON, because otherwise an uncovered sibling can be imported at runtime while checksums bless a different helper.
evidence: Standard CAS 019f30c0-7d51-7e43-9e25-3864fbe9bde4 found Bun could resolve helper.jsx or helper.mts outside the candidate list; adding .jsx/.mts/.cts/.json coverage plus regressions kept bun test and bun run proof passing.
record.application: For future import-resolution changes, validate candidate extensions against the runtime and add both uncovered-shadow and covered-helper tests before review-closeout.

record.learning: When adapter manifest() returns policy metadata that validation also reads, prefer returning a cloned or frozen manifest because otherwise caller mutation can alter later preflight or resolve policy decisions after verification.
evidence: Standard CAS 019f30cc-7f84-7761-8865-e62e456cfbda found packManifest arrays returned by manifest() were the same authority sets used by preEffectReason; structuredClone returns and an isolation regression fixed it with bun test and bun run proof passing.
record.application: For future adapter metadata changes, test that mutating manifest() output cannot change subsequent policy metadata before review-closeout.

record.learning: When a scanner expands an executable artifact predicate, prefer reusing that shared predicate in every downstream validator and adding false-positive tests, because duplicated regexes and broad heuristics can reject valid packs after the security fix.
evidence: Standard CAS 019f30f1-d3a8-7781-9d08-e3d312b1aa80 found sidecar entrypoint validation still omitted .jsx/.mts/.cts and computed-member detection rejected safe array literals; sharing EXECUTABLE_ARTIFACT and narrowing computed access kept bun test and bun run proof passing.
record.application: For future self-containment scanner changes, search for duplicated extension predicates and add at least one safe data-literal regression beside bypass regressions.

record.learning: When sidecar command validation derives an entrypoint from executable-looking arguments, prefer rejecting code-loading runtime flags before entrypoint selection because option payloads can masquerade as checksum-bound entrypoints while the real sidecar runs unchecked.
evidence: CAS invariant-ace rer_fab1e6be990e314500edb520b3545be30cc92846b32c221f1a4b8ef9d6f20de4 found bun --preload loader.jsx sidecar.mjs bypass; local repro printed BUG_REPRODUCED before fix; bun test and bun run proof passed after rejecting preload flags.
record.application: Keep sidecar runtime option parsing ahead of artifact/entrypoint binding and add regression coverage when adding executable extensions or runtime flags.

record.learning: When local import coverage handles directory specifiers, prefer modeling the runtime index resolution candidates because appending extensions to a trailing slash can bless shadow files while the runtime executes unchecked index modules.
evidence: Standard CAS rer_ece355acadb85ee6bc4f2d89b9e02e83fb2dc74e228b87ac8f467379476773b8 found import './helper/' could checksum helper/.js while Bun executes helper/index.js; local repro printed BUG_REPRODUCED before fix; bun test and bun run proof passed after covering index candidates.
record.application: For future import candidate changes, test trailing-slash directory imports alongside extensionless files and require coverage of runtime index targets.

record.learning: When supporting trailing-slash directory imports in a pack scanner, prefer rejecting package.json-backed directories unless package-main resolution is fully modeled because Bun can execute main/module targets before index fallbacks.
evidence: Standard CAS rer_a7c30d4084c3c72dbf896813c6a31bfed2ff9dd077459cc9b69fb276480ec751 found helper/package.json main could redirect ./helper/ to unchecked main.js; package-backed directory import repro now rejects; bun test and bun run proof passed.
record.application: For future directory import support, cover or reject package.json main/module/export paths explicitly instead of assuming index.* is sufficient.

record.learning: When hardening JavaScript self-containment scanner heuristics, treat review findings as an adversarial grammar corpus: replace broad regex matches with delimiter and context helpers, make Unicode identifiers and method/class/extends contexts first-class, and add both bypass and false-positive regressions before rerunning tuple-matched CAS.
evidence: CAS review findings in PR #1 exposed bypasses from regex/default/template braces, Unicode function and method names, word-operator divisions, private/bigint methods, and a quadratic comma scan in harness/pack-utils.mjs.
record.application: For future pack scanner changes, add targeted tests in test/adapter_self_containment.test.mjs for each grammar context, run bun proof, and reset the CAS clean streak after every scanner mutation.

record.learning: When a self-containment scanner uses broad computed-member regexes, run them on literal-stripped executable source because string and regex payload text such as object[key] or name[abc] is data, not executable member access.
evidence: CAS rer_1b74d5cc5e87f66649fe47319552a3eef74b1fd61e5bef1de313562f639137e0 found harness/pack-utils.mjs matched computed member access against loaderSource; switching to codeSource plus adapter_self_containment regression kept bun test, bun run proof, bun run packs:verify, and git diff --check passing.
record.application: For future lexical scanner hardening, bind broad token regexes to stripped executable source and add false-positive regressions for data literals before CAS closeout.

record.learning: When broad unsafe-loader syntax patterns scan transformed JavaScript, run them on literal-stripped executable source unless the pattern intentionally reasons about literal composition, because inert labels and regex payloads can otherwise reject valid packs.
evidence: CAS rer_ab4bfcbb35f25e5f7c72f8114aeaf77c2b33ebe50ac63d64414c02631ee93c43 found EVAL_PATTERNS still matched loader-looking string text after computed-member stripping moved to codeSource; moving EVAL_PATTERNS to codeSource plus literal regressions kept bun test, bun run proof, bun run packs:verify, and git diff --check passing.
record.application: For future scanner regexes, classify each pattern as executable-token, literal-composition, or import-grammar before choosing loaderSource versus codeSource.

record.learning: When validating sidecar commands, prefer classifying the entrypoint as a local artifact path before extension or artifact binding because package-scheme specifiers such as npm: or jsr: can share an executable suffix while resolving outside the pack.
evidence: CAS rer_5d86e81a53446d4f474535ae93b97e4c2e674bc4e5817aa501dfc28423dab5ba found deno run npm:pkg/mod.mjs could be artifact-bound by literal path; isLocalSidecarEntrypoint plus sidecar_security regression kept bun test, bun run proof, bun run packs:verify, and git diff --check passing.
record.application: For future sidecar runtime support, reject URL/package schemes before checking executable extensions or manifest artifact paths.
